title: Nutty Velvety Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: A nutty and velvety Greek dish featuring lamb kebabs marinated in a mixture of beer, olive oil, and spices, then grilled to perfection and served with a side of tangy tzatziki sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together beer, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the chopped pistachios in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned.
Once the lamb is cooked, brush the kebabs with the toasted pistachios and serve hot with a side of tzatziki sauce.
To deglaze the grill or grill pan, pour a small amount of beer or water over the hot surface and scrape up any browned bits with a spatula.
Serve the lamb kebabs with the deglazed sauce spooned over the top and a side of warm pita bread or roasted vegetables.
